fields.name: cnt
fields.description: A count of records matching the table definitions
fields.details: Counts are generally on a patient or encounter level, but may be of any FHIR resource. Consult the table description for more information.

fields.name: class_display
fields.description: The context in which the encounter occured
fields.details: Corresponds to the display values in https://hl7.org/fhir/R4/v3/ActEncounterCode/vs.html

fields.name: type_display
fields.description: The type of interaction with medical staff
fields.details: Corresponds to the display values in https://tx.fhir.org/r4/ValueSet/2.16.840.1.113762.1.4.1267.23-20250510

fields.name: serviceType_display
fields.description: The type of service being provided
fields.details: Corresponds to the display values in https://hl7.org/fhir/R4B/valueset-service-type.html

fields.name: priority_display
fields.description: The priority of service being provided
fields.details: Corresponds to the display values in https://terminology.hl7.org/3.1.0/ValueSet-v3-ActPriority.html

fields.name: period_start_month
fields.description: The month in which the encounter began
